title: Hide and Seek
description: Hide and Seek — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Illiot Fess - Kingdom Agent

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Locate the missing Agent, Matt Roach, somewhere on Level 5 of Algernon.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Illiot Fess - Kingdom Agent

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Not a Front

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Locate the missing Agent, Matt Roach, somewhere on Level 5 of Algernon.

Offer:

Ugh, can you smell that? It smells like flaming Whisker crap floating in one of Audrey's potions. I mean wow, that is strong! It's been coming up from Algernon for the past while. We're thinking about placing doors over the entrance of the dungeon to try and keep it out. We've tried everything else: burning matches, scented candles. Hughard even tried constructing a large fan-like...thing from Wolf Pelts. Why do you think he keeps asking for more pelts from Samford? Well, the idea didn't work.

I sent one of my Agents down into Algernon to figure out just what is causing that smell. And then to kill it, or burn it, or banish it with the power of Gosh. I haven't heard back from him yet, and the smell is still there. I suspect he either got lost, succumbed to the fumes, or was accosted by a particuarly rude Broodling. Either way, I need you to find him (or what's left of him) and see if he found a way to stop this.

Gah, ok I am going to hold my breath until you come back. So be quick! Oh and bring a shovel with you...just in case.

Turn-in:

Hey there. Do you smell something?

Objectives:

  • Locate Agent Roach

Level range: 5–20
